I don’t have access to live weather feeds, so I can’t give you the current conditions right now.  
If you’re looking for up‑to‑date information, you can check a reliable weather service such as:

- **Weather.com** (search “San Francisco, CA”)
- **AccuWeather** (search “San Francisco, CA”)
- **National Weather Service** (https://www.weather.gov/)
- Your phone’s built‑in weather app

**Typical San Francisco weather (seasonal overview)**  
| Season | Avg. High | Avg. Low | Notes |
|--------|-----------|----------|-------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | ~12 °C (54 °F) | ~7 °C (45 °F) | Cool, often foggy, occasional rain |
| Spring (Mar–May) | ~15 °C (59 °F) | ~9 °C (48 °F) | Mild, less fog, more sunshine |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | ~20 °C (68 °F) | ~13 °C (55 °F) | Warm, dry, “June Gloom” early, clear later |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | ~18 °C (64 °F) | ~12 °C (54 °F) | Pleasant, decreasing fog, more rain toward November |

If you need the current temperature, wind speed, humidity, or forecast, let me know and I can guide you on how to retrieve it from a specific API or website.
